basic_details.job_title: DCPU Support Persons Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 20 Posts
basic_details.short_information: The District Child Protection Unit (DCPU), Coimbatore has invited applications for 20 Support Persons posts under the POCSO Act, 2012 and the POCSO Rules, 2020. The application must be sent to the DCPU office in Coimbatore by 30 November 2026. The notice is in Tamil, and the notice text available to this site is only partly readable.

qualification.details: The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification in the readable text. Candidates should check the official notification for the eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: DCPU Support Persons at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification text available here does not clearly give the qualification, the age limit or the application fee.

rows.details: 10,000/- and Rs.2500/- are printed in the notice

content_sections.heading: About DCPU
content_sections.text: The notice comes from the District Child Protection Unit in Coimbatore. It deals with the engagement of Support Persons under the POCSO Act, 2012 and POCSO Rules, 2020, and refers to the CWC and DCPU.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application is to be sent to the DCPU office in Coimbatore, PIN 641018, at the postal address printed in the notice, by 30.11.2026. Whether the date is for receipt or dispatch could not be read. The official website named in the notice is https://coimbatore.nic.in .

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification in the readable text. Candidates should check the official notification for the eligibility conditions of the post.
